title.narrative: Desk research on EU funds for supporting the implementation of EIPP projects in Hungary

description.narrative: The Economic Innovation Partnership Programme (EIPP) is a collaborative initiative between the Republic of Korea (Korea) and Hungary aimed at fostering green and innovation-led growth. The program, coordinated by the Korea Development Institute (KDI), seeks to strengthen innovation capacities and develop joint projects between Korea and partner countries.Hungary is one of the partner countries of the EIPP. Under the EIPP in Hungary, ﬁve joint projects have been identiﬁed for development with the Hungarian Government, focusing on the electric mobility and vocational training to equip the work force with the necessary skills. These projects aim to achieve policy objectives and enhance economic cooperation between Korea and Hungary. The implementation timeline for these projects spans three years, and all are currently under implementation.The engagement seeks to support the implementation of the EIPP projects in Hungary by advising KDI on potential project funding and ﬁnancing opportunities, with a special focus on European Union (EU) funding mechanisms and sources. The rationale behind this project is to assist KDI in identifying EU ﬁnancing opportunities to ensure the successful implementation of the EIPP projects.
